previous_description: A declarative placeholder in a parent component's named slot, pointing to another component to be rendered there. Unlike ComponentInstance (a concrete rendered occurrence), ComponentReference is a composition declaration that says 'render this component in this slot of the parent', analogous to the HTML slot element.
definition: A composition declaration attached to a parent component that names one of the parent's slots and identifies, by specNodeId, the library component or component instance to be rendered into that slot. It records the slot-filling relationship only; it carries no props of its own and is not itself a rendered occurrence.

distinguish_from.when: the element is a concrete, configured usage of a library component with its own props and render order inside a View or SubView, rather than a pointer filling a parent's named slot.
the element defines a reusable component's props, slots and events schema, rather than declaring what fills one slot of a parent.
the embedded content is a grouping of several components placed in a View's subViews list, not a single component placed into a named slot of a parent component.

standard_reference: HTML 5.3 §4.12.4 The slot element (Web Components named slots)
code_evidence: A child element carrying a slot="header"/slot="actions" attribute, a Vue <template #footer> / v-slot directive, or an Angular <ng-content select=...> projection target being filled.
A React prop typed as ReactNode or render-prop (e.g. header={<Toolbar/>}, actions={<Button variant="compact"/>}) passed to a layout or container component.
A Storybook or design-system doc listing a component's slots together with the allowed child components for each slot (e.g. 'Card.footer accepts Button | Link').
notes: The 'implements → librarycomponent' relationship is semantically odd for a slot pointer; 'references' fits better. Self-referential 'renders' is listed twice (outgoing and incoming). 'variant' must match variants on the referenced component, but LibraryComponent declares no variants attribute, so this constraint is unverifiable. Consider a 'props' override, or state explicitly that props are not permitted.
